- Drop the traceback, context and cause of the exception kept by `connection_lost`. They reference the transport, which references the protocol, so every dropped connection (protocol, buffers and, for TLS, the SSL transport and its state) stayed alive until a full gc pass. Idle processes that recycle pooled TLS connections grew steadily (#171).
- Fix `BufferError: Existing exports of data` when fetching a row larger than 256 KiB on Windows (`ProactorEventLoop`). The receive buffer now grows into a replaceme

- Fix `BufferError: Existing exports of data` when fetching a row larger than 256 KiB on
  Windows (`ProactorEventLoop`). The receive buffer now grows into a replacement buffer
  instead of resizing a bytearray the transport still holds (#170).
- Keep the receive buffer shared across TLS reads, so successive SSL records fill one
  contiguous buffer instead of being split across copies.
- Optimize pooled prepared-query execution and refresh the benchmark suite.
- Drop Python 3.9 support; asyncmy now requires

- Preserve negative `timedelta` values, including subsecond durations, when binding
  text-protocol parameters to `TIME` columns (#166).
- Drain every unread streaming result before advancing, closing the cursor, or sending
  another command. Discard abandoned streaming connections during finalization without
  creating unawaited cleanup coroutines (#165).
- Build wheels for Python 3.15 and free-threaded 3.15t. cibuildwheel 4 no longer builds
  free-threaded 3.13t, so 3.13t wheels are dropped and pip builds

- Make `Connection.ensure_closed()` tear the connection down locally instead of raising
  `OperationalError(2006)` when the server already closed the stream, so pool invalidation of a
  dead connection (e.g. SQLAlchemy `do_terminate`) no longer fails.
- Fix `SSDictCursor` returning tuples instead of dictionaries, and honor custom `dict_type`
  subclasses when fetching unbuffered rows (#164).
